paper_title: UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection experiment: A precision frequency interferometric axion dark matter search with a Cylindrical Microwave Cavity
notes: Corrected version (erratum) of UPLOAD-CMC AC haloscope. Measured 95% CL limits: g_agamma > 3e-3 1/GeV excluded between 7.44-19.38 neV (upconversion), and g_agamma > 1e-2 1/GeV excluded between 74.4-74.5 ueV (downconversion). Values are flat (mass-independent) limits over the two stated ranges, encoded as horizontal segments. Local DM density taken as 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (8e-22 kg/m3). vc=225 km/s Maxwell-Boltzmann halo.
